Cost.definition: Cost of transportation for route from terminal i to destination j

objective.description: "Minimize the total transportation cost of shipping soybeans from terminals to destinations across all routes"

constraints.description: For each terminal k, the total amount shipped from terminal k to all destinations must not exceed its supply: sum over j of amount_{k,j} <= Supply_k
For each destination l, the total amount received from all terminals must satisfy its demand: sum over i of amount_{i,l} >= Demand_l
All shipment amounts must be non-negative: amount_{i,j} >= 0 for all routes (i,j)

amount.definition: Amount of soybeans shipped from terminal k to destination j
